== the different ages ==

2: starts with the discovery of the One Power, learning to use it for more and more, ends with the discovery of the Dark One's prison(age of legends)<br />
3: starts after the breaking, ends with Tarmon Gai'Don<br />
4: A mix of the previous ages; technology as in the first age, miracles with the One Powers like the second, though without the "innocence" of that age, leading to wars like the third age. <br />
